methodology.scope: Rankings include games, expansions, remasters, remakes, and ports; DLC, demos, and bundles are excluded.
methodology.mostReviewed: Total Steam user reviews (all languages, all purchase types, off-topic review bombs filtered by Steam).
methodology.highestRated: Steam positive review percentage; only games with at least 500 reviews. Ties broken by review count.
methodology.mostPlayed: Concurrent players reported by Steam at retrieval time (a single snapshot, not a peak).
methodology.recentlyPopular: New Steam reviews per day over the last ~30 days, measured from stored review-count history.
methodology.mostRecent: Most recent release date among released games.
methodology.mostEstablished: Earliest release date among games with at least 1000 Steam reviews.
methodology.averagePositivePercentage: Unweighted mean of per-game positive percentages, games with at least 50 reviews.
methodology.weightedPositivePercentage: Sum of positive reviews / sum of all reviews across the company's games.
methodology.reviewVelocity: Review growth is not sales. See docs/STATISTICS.md.
